title: Workplace stress check
intro: This short questionnaire helps you reflect on your current stress levels. It is not a diagnosis.

questions.text: In the last month, how often have you felt unable to control important things in your life?
In the last month, how often have you felt confident about your ability to handle personal problems?
In the last month, how often have you felt things were going your way?
In the last month, how often have you felt difficulties were piling up so high you could not overcome them?

bands.title: Low perceived stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest low levels of perceived stress. Maintaining healthy habits can help you stay on track.
bands.nextStep: Explore our wellbeing articles for tips on maintaining balance.

bands.title: Moderate perceived stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest moderate stress. Consider exploring support resources available through your programme.
bands.nextStep: Speak with a wellbeing professional through your employer's programme.

bands.title: High perceived stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest higher levels of perceived stress. Professional support may be beneficial.
bands.nextStep: We recommend booking a confidential session with a psychologist through your programme.

disclaimer: This self-assessment is for informational purposes only and does not constitute a medical or psychological diagnosis. If you are in crisis, please contact the emergency services listed below.
